messages:
mira (PM): Quick thread to lock the EU rollout plan for model-v2. Key constraints: p95 <= 400ms, 5xx < 0.5%, quality delta <= 0.5% vs v1. Need per-tenant opt-in for early customers and instant fallback. Thoughts?
ben (Eng): Proposing this flow: 1) shadow traffic for 3h with detailed sampling, 2) per-tenant opt-in canary at 1% for 6h, 3) broad canary 10% 12h, 4) ramp to 50% over 48h. Keep conservative batching and disable heavy KV cache priming until ramp.
jas (SRE): Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p95 > 700ms for 5m OR quality A/B regression > 1%. Need automated circuit-breaker to flip flag and notify on-call. Also require a manual kill-switch in console + CLI.
tara (CS): Two EU customers asked to opt-in next week. We need per-tenant flag and an opt-in confirmation flow (email + dashboard toggle). Also include short beta SLA note: no changes to contractual uptime until GA.
kevin (Security): For Private/Dedicated customers, ensure KMS enforced, telemetry scrub PII, and audit logs enabled. I'll prepare a short compliance checklist and sign-off criteria.
ash (Infra): Autoscaling: min 2 nodes, scale on GPU utilization + request latency. For canary we'll reserve a warm pool to avoid cold-start spikes. Add per-tenant throttling during canary to prevent noisy neighbor issues.
ben (Eng): Flag config (will add to ops):
```json
{
  "flag": "eu_model_v2",
  "phases": [
    {"name":"shadow","pct":0,"duration":"3h","sampling":"100% requests sampled for eval"},
    {"name":"optin-canary","pct":1,"duration":"6h","per_tenant_opt_in":true},
    {"name":"wide-canary","pct":10,"duration":"12h"},
    {"name":"ramp","pct":50,"duration":"48h"}
  ],
  "kill_switch":true,
  "rollback_conditions": ["5xx>1%_3m","p95>700ms_5m","quality_drop>1%" ]
}
```
mira (PM): Good. Deliverables before opt-in: runbook, per-tenant toggle UI + email template, security checklist, and a small experiment plan for A/B quality checks.
jas (SRE): Runbook items: preflight synthetic smoke, latency spike sim, verify fallback flips flag within 10s, post-cutover verification queries, dashboard panel (p50/p95/p99, errors, quality delta). Also set alert thresholds and escalation path.
ben (Eng): We'll include canary-specific traffic shaping knobs: max tokens per request, batch size limit, and short-circuit for long-running requests. I'll also add a lightweight verification harness that runs ~100 golden prompts every hour.
tara (CS): I'll draft the opt-in email and a short FAQ. Can we set opt-in window to start next Tue 09:00 UTC?
mira (PM): Tentatively yes — final after preflight. Preflight meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Owners: ben=rollout lead, jas=SRE lead, tara=customer comms, kevin=security sign-off, ash=infra.
deploy-bot: canary-schedule created: eu_model_v2 @1766005800 phase=shadow
kevin (Security): I'll review the telemetry filters and post checklist updates by EOD.
ash (Infra): Adding per-tenant throttle cap to config; will share values in the runbook.
ben (Eng): I'll post links to the runbook + experiment IDs in this thread once live.
mira (PM): Please add a short rollback verification clip (3 steps) we can run during lunch. Need the checklist in thread before we start shadow.
